sourceReview.reason: The November 13 headline asserts $4.5 billion and second place in tokenized funds, but the accessible Stellar primary page reports $4 billion as of September 1, 2026, and the available independent reporting uses older or differently defined RWA metrics. No current dated primary dataset or two independent full-text reports verify the exact new ranking and $4.5 billion claim. Recheck no sooner than six hours after reviewedAt.
